user.title: LuxPower WiFi dongle
user.description: Enter the IP address of the WiFi dongle. The dongle serial is on its sticker; the inverter serial is on the inverter label (both 10 characters).

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a TCP connection to the dongle. Check the IP address and port (8000), and that nothing else is blocking it.
error.no_reply: Connected to the dongle, but the inverter did not reply. Check both serial numbers, then enable debug logging for custom_components.luxpower_lxp and check the log.
error.serial_mismatch: Connected, but the dongle reports different serials: dongle {seen_dongle}, inverter {seen_inverter}. Enter these values and try again.
error.invalid_serial: Serial numbers must be exactly 10 characters.

write_holding_register.name: Write holding register
write_holding_register.description: Write a raw value to an inverter holding register. Only use this if you know the register map.

config_entry_id.name: Inverter
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if more than one inverter is configured.
